units.source_text: 次晨，日出之后，才留恋不舍地起身。

en.t: The next morning, after the sun had risen, he finally got up, reluctant to leave.

units.source_text: 推开东面的边门一看，直对这门的走廊已经坍损，连顶棚也没有了。

en.t: When he pushed open the side door on the east and looked out, the corridor directly facing it had already fallen into ruin, and even its roof was gone.

units.source_text: 因此太阳光直射进屋里。

en.t: Because of this, sunlight streamed straight into the room.

units.source_text: 地上积着薄薄的一层雪，白光反映进来，屋里更加明亮了。

en.t: A thin layer of snow lay on the ground, and its white brightness reflected inside, making the room even lighter.

units.source_text: 源氏公子身穿常礼服，小姐眼睛望着他，向前膝行数步，装作半坐半卧的姿势，头的形状十分端正。

en.t: Prince Genji was dressed in his ordinary formal robes, and the young lady, gazing at him, moved forward a few steps on her knees and assumed a half-sitting, half-reclining posture; the shape of her head was very well formed.

units.source_text: 那长长的头发堆积在席地上，甚是美观。

en.t: Her long hair lay heaped upon the matting, and it was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子希望看到她的相貌也变得同头发一样美丽，便把格子窗掀开。

en.t: Hoping that her face might also appear as beautiful as her hair, Prince Genji raised the lattice shutter.

units.source_text: 他想起上次在积雪的明光中看出了她的缺陷，以致大杀风景，因此不把格子窗全部掀开，只掀开一点，

en.t: He remembered how, last time, the bright snowlight had revealed her flaws and spoiled the moment, so he did not raise the lattice shutter all the way, but opened it only a little,

units.source_text: 把矮几拉过来架住窗扇，然后拢拢自己的鬓发。

en.t: pulled over a low table to prop up the shutter, and then smoothed his own sidelocks.

units.source_text: 侍女们端过一架十分古旧的镜台来，又奉上一只中国式的化妆品箱和一只梳具箱。

en.t: The maidservants brought over a very old-fashioned mirror stand, and also presented a Chinese-style cosmetic box and a box of combing tools.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一看，里面除女子用品外，又夹着几件男子用的梳具，倒觉得很别致。

en.t: When Prince Genji looked inside, he saw that, besides women's articles, several men's grooming implements had been mixed in, which he found rather charming.

units.source_text: 今天小姐的装束颇入时流，原来她已经把公子所惠赠的那箱衣服全部穿上了。

en.t: The young lady's dress today was quite fashionable; it turned out that she had put on everything from the box of clothes the prince had kindly given her.

units.source_text: 源氏公子没有注意到，只是看见那件纹样新颖触目的衫子，才想起是他所赠送的。

en.t: Prince Genji had not noticed at first; only when he saw the robe with its striking new pattern did he remember that it was one he had given her.

units.source_text: 便对她说：“新春到了，我很想听一听你的娇声。

en.t: He then said to her, "The New Year has come, and I would very much like to hear your lovely voice.

units.source_text: 主要倒不是为了那盼待已久的莺声，而是希望你改变态度。”

en.t: It is not mainly for the long-awaited song of the warbler, but because I hope you will change your manner."

units.source_text: 过了好久，小姐才用颤抖的声音含羞答道：“百鸟争鸣万物春……”[\[20\]](#part1335.html#m20)

en.t: After a long while, the young lady answered shyly in a trembling voice, "When all the birds vie in song, all things are spring..." [\[20\]](#part1335.html#m20)

units.source_text: 源氏公子笑道：“好了，好了，这便是一年来进步的证据了。”

en.t: Prince Genji laughed and said, "Good, good. This is proof of a year's progress."

units.source_text: 他便告辞出门，口中吟唱着古歌“依稀恍惚还疑梦……”[\[21\]](#part1335.html#m21)小姐半坐半卧地目送他。

en.t: He then took his leave and went out, chanting an old poem under his breath, "So dim and dreamlike that I still wonder if it was a dream..." [\[21\]](#part1335.html#m21) The young lady watched him go, still half sitting and half reclining.

units.source_text: 源氏公子回头一望，看见她的侧影，掩口的衣袖上面，那鼻尖上的末摘花依然显著地突出着。

en.t: When Prince Genji turned back and looked, he saw her profile; above the sleeve that covered her mouth, the safflower at the tip of her nose still protruded conspicuously.

units.source_text: 他想：“真难看啊！”

en.t: He thought, "How unsightly!"
